cot_history.reasoning_cot: My strategy prioritizes survival by bidding aggressively when HP is low. It dynamically adjusts bids based on current supply-demand. Crucially, it reacts to opponents' 'previous_trace' by raising bids if yesterday's competition was high, or lowering them if opponents bid conservatively, balancing competitiveness with budget management.

Prioritize survival by bidding aggressively at low HP or after missing water. Dynamically adjust bids based on supply/demand and react to opponent's previous high bids (from previous_trace) to win efficiently, otherwise bid conservatively.

My strategy prioritizes my HP, bidding higher when critically low. I dynamically adjust my bid based on opponents' previous day bids (from 'previous_trace'), increasing it if they showed high aggression. I also consider supply scarcity and end-game pressure to optimize my chances.

Eric and Alex are highly aggressive, often bidding above 100. My strategy prioritizes survival by dynamically adjusting bids based on my HP, current supply, and opponents' previous bids, aiming to outbid strong opponents, especially when supply is low or my HP is critical, while managing my budget.

Exploiting David and Eric's high bids by reacting to the highest previous bid. If competition is high, I bid aggressively when my HP is low, otherwise I conserve. If competition is moderate, I slightly outbid to secure water. Otherwise, I bid based on my HP and game day.

Exploit Eric's high average bid to secure water when needed, bidding aggressively if HP is low or if Eric previously bid high. Conserve budget by bidding moderately when HP is healthy and opponent bids are not extreme. Weak opponents are ignored.

My strategy adapts to opponent aggression (Alex/Eric) by reacting to yesterday's highest bid. It prioritizes survival with higher bids when HP is low, and conserves budget with capped bids when healthy. Late game days trigger more aggressive bidding to secure survival.

My strategy dynamically reacts to yesterday's highest opponent bid to stay competitive. It prioritizes survival by bidding aggressively when my HP is low or water supply is scarce, while adjusting to ensure I don't exceed my budget.

Alex and David consistently bid high and survived. Given the low supply (15-25) relative to water requirements (13), there's almost always only one full water slot. My strategy prioritizes survival by bidding aggressively, particularly when HP is low or supply is extremely scarce, often exceeding strong opponents' past bids.

Bob and Eric are aggressive high-bidders, David is conservative. My strategy prioritizes survival when HP is low by bidding very high. When healthy, I adapt to yesterday's highest bid, incrementally exceeding it, and bid more aggressively if supply is tight or less so if supply is more generous, balancing competition and budget.
